author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. Character art: realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; lighter fantasy book; open to styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now, more if the style fits the series. Map: detailed, immersive, classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites. No budget stated. Still receiving artist replies; not marked closed.

author: Bee (Shel)
title: Paid character and concept art for adult fantasy series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I am a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and looking for artists to help bring it to life. Starting small, but this is paid work. Looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators drop your work + rates. Follow-up (2026-09-13): overwhelmed by responses, still early, actively figuring out funding and budgeting, planning more posts about the show. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @bee.chaoticcore with work and rates. No budget stated. Not marked closed.
